findings.description: Defaulting `min` to 1 changes existing subsecond waits and can cause the strategy to exceed an explicitly configured maximum.
findings.rationale: For example, `wait_exponential_jitter(max=0.5)` previously returned at most 0.5 seconds. With the new default, line 273 clamps every result to at least 1 second, so callers that do not supply the new argument now wait twice their configured maximum. Defaulting `min` to 0 would preserve existing behavior.
